Best crop we ever grew

Hannah and the children will bring in the rest

Short. Hannah's string says we're closer than that. [sighs] I keep my mouth shut

Yes, sir. Yes, sir

40 cents on every dollar just for waiting till Christmas

25%. He said 10. He said it to my face
